title: Lateen acceptance report
description: What the public acceptance gate checked on one candidate: the commit, the sha256 of the exact tarball it installed, the exact Mizzen version, and one result per case. The release workflow requires this report before it publishes and rejects a report whose commit, digest or engine does not match the candidate.

commit.description: The commit the candidate was packed from.

digest.description: The sha256 of the tarball the gate installed, as hex.

mizzen.description: The exact engine version installed beside the candidate, not the range.

tarball.description: The file name of the tested tarball. Publishing uses this name and no other.

ok.description: True only when every case passed.

error.description: Why the case failed; absent when it passed.
